services.desc: A Different Kind of Pedal Pub! Your social adventure awaits! PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE BOOKING A PUBLIC CRUISE We require a minimum of 5 people for a public cruise and we will do our best to group smaller parties together to meet the minimum. If you are booking an empty time slot with less than the minimum, but are planning on additional people booking to meet the minimum, please add that info to the notes or call to book. If the minimum is not met within a reasonable time, we will contact you to reschedule, cancel, or purchase the remaining seats to meet the minimum.
